fields.name: Device Rogue Alert
fields.subject: ALERT - Rogue Device Detected
fields.body:
QWERX detected an unauthorized device event on network {{ network.name }}.

Device: {{ device.name }} ({{ device.id }})
MAC: {{ device.mac_address }}
Status: {{ device.status }}
Reason: {{ reason }}
Time: {{ system_time }} {{ date }}

fields.name: Device Cloned Alert
fields.subject: ALERT - Cloned Device Detected
fields.body:

Device: {{ device.name }} ({{ device.id }})
MAC: {{ device.mac_address }}
Reason: {{ reason }}
Time: {{ system_time }} {{ date }}

fields.name: Device Reprovisioned
fields.subject: Device Reprovisioned on QWERX
fields.body:
Hi {{ user.first_name }},

Your device {{ device.name }} on network {{ network.name }} was reprovisioned.

Device ID: {{ device.id }}
MAC: {{ device.mac_address }}
Time: {{ system_time }} {{ date }}
